subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sloppy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Dashing)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sloppy"** means something that is careless, untidy, or lacking neatness. (अस्त-व्यस्त, बेपरवाह)

 
 
• **Example:** His sloppy handwriting made it difficult to read the notes.
 
 
 
• **"Dashing"** refers to someone or something that is neat, stylish, or attractive, often exuding confidence and charm. (आकर्षक, शानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** He looked dashing in his formal suit at the wedding reception.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Sloppy'** is **'Dashing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Dashing)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Untidy** (अस्त-व्यस्त): Not neat or organized; messy.

 
 
• **Example:** Her untidy room was filled with clothes scattered everywhere.
 
 
 
• **Humid** (नम): Having a high level of moisture in the air.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was hot and humid during the monsoon season.
 
 
 
• **Rough** (खुरदरा): Not smooth or even; coarse or irregular.
 
 
• **Example:** The surface of the old table felt rough to the touch.
